name: oms360-qa-newman
description: Newman/Postman regression suite for the OMS-360 Enterprise Food Delivery Platform QA infrastructure. Reports: CLI, JSON, HTML Extra, JUnit XML, and Allure raw results (merged with pytest's into the repo-root allure-results/ for one unified Enterprise Allure report).

scripts.test:full: newman run collection/OMS360.postman_collection.json -e environment/OMS360.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json,htmlextra,junit,allure --reporter-json-export reports/newman-json-report.json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-html-report.html --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-junit-report.xml --reporter-allure-resultsDir ../allure-results
